families.name: Original stiff solver, matrix-free and reuse
families.finding: Shared shifted operator / JVP and residual-controlled GMRES are implemented. V17 reduces instruction counts. A common-W approximation failed parity under PR65.
families.next_discriminator: Keep the actual residual for each stage. Measure achieved-error full-IVP with sparse and expensive JVP separately.

families.name: Causal transactions and stage enclosures
families.finding: R7 accepted 8 q1 and 113 q2 steps without fallback, but the transactional method took 4.746 times protected wall at matched achieved error on the three independent small source problems. Source substitution is a concrete N01 counterexample repaired with a frozen source.
families.next_discriminator: Reserve transaction for costly RHS with a measured opportunity and tail-bound witness on the original stage equation. Multiplier includes failed attempts, speculative work and callback cost.

families.name: Flexible Krylov, conditional interval source boxes and events
families.finding: P09/P10 have native source on historical REI branch 6844c8fe; new port has its own verification record. P11 has a native scalar-affine implementation on 8357faa5. An interval box does not itself establish its model membership.
families.next_discriminator: Measure flexible JVP work at equal true residual. Validate source epoch, norm, roundoff and operator on every interval adoption. P11 requires event missed-crossing and localization tests.

families.name: Nonlinear algebraic homotopy & monotone cooperative systems
families.finding: RHS-only stage roots, nonlinear BE inverse-Picard, and rowwise monotone root recovery are available on restricted domains. Original RODAS stages are linear systems; a BE-stage solution alone does not compute the same RODAS step.
families.next_discriminator: Check the actual original residual in its physical norm and bounded inverse, retain full-IVP achieved-order and work versus protected RODAS and BDF. Test near loss of monotonicity.

families.name: Algebraic/singular geometry and trace with multiplicity
families.finding: Bounded polynomial cyclic-closure example: 24 passing and 12 nonadmitted cells retained. Trace over all complex roots counts algebraic multiplicity. Median paired trajectory ratio 1.00837, 4 faster vs 3 slower. Selected-real-root semantics and multivariate closure remain open.
families.next_discriminator: Detect cofactor/regularity, retain multiplicity under coalescence and fallback on vanishing chart denominators; compare near repeated root and over an entire time slab under original RHS.

families.name: ODE dynamical systems & symbolic route dynamics
families.finding: Nonnormal weighted logarithmic norms, bounded symbolic cells and hybrid guard traces are present. The route automaton is an offline verifier. Product-norm bounds for long guarded words can be orders of magnitude too loose.
families.next_discriminator: Before using a runtime switch, replay rejected and accepted steps chronologically with dwell/failure costs, and compare weighted lognorm vs eigenvalue on a nonnormal Jordan block and MOL operator.

families.name: Algebraic topology, spatial MOL, global geometry
families.finding: Incidence/Hodge check in a test; sphere manufactured data exist in the research/bench layers. Several BASS PRs are trajectory postprocessing with no new IVP. Individual physical artifacts are not external validation of a spatial solver.
families.next_discriminator: Require exact incidence composition zero, area/mass weighting, a constant nullspace and mesh refinement. Exercise sphere, planar and volume fixtures with temporal and spatial errors separated.

families.name: Rosenbrock stage dependency, structural alternatives and graph solvers
families.finding: Two exact tableau scripts recover causal depth 8 for the opaque RHS and nilpotency index 7 for the transformed k coupling. PR186 proves a source-specific affine path scan; PR187 measured path length 1 and no useful scan work. Different depth-5/6 tableaux did not win on their matched-error cells.
families.next_discriminator: Exploit declared separable/affine structure or change tableau with independently checked order, stability, intermediate stage growth and achieved-error cost. For path scan require real long paths, synchronized workers and residual checks.

families.name: Shared basis, FD assembly, linear solvers and practical work recovery
families.finding: B/C (per-stage/shared JVP) improved in every recorded nonlinear cell; stage-a criterion only passed for Gray-Scott. Generic admission failed. FD likewise sped up dense expensive RHS but lost for narrow colored bands.
families.next_discriminator: Gate reuse by measured overlap and charge orthogonalization, sparse matvec and fallback. Isolate RHS evaluation throughput from whole-IVP achieved-error wall.

families.name: Peer-W, unified facade and production verdict
families.finding: PPSW1 depth passed in U11. Steps reached 7.1 times protected; median relative six-thread speed 0.006 on small holdouts. Dense J and starter Newton violate its target fast-path requirements. Protected RODAS is the fallback; no new production admission.
families.next_discriminator: Use method-specific contracts including dense output and startup. Require held-out matched-error and external comparator runs to change the broad qualification.
